subject: general
question: Which of the following countries was NOT among the top four producers of wheat in the world, according to Food and Agricultural Organization, in 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Canada.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

**Wheat production in Canada**

__
 
• Canada was not among the top four producers of wheat in the world, according to Food and Agricultural Organization, in 2020.
 
• **In 2020,** wheat production for **Canada was 35,183 thousand tonnes. **
 
• Canada is the fifth largest wheat producer in the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Top 4 producers of wheat in the world**

 
• **In 2020, wheat production for China** was **134,250 thousand tonnes.**
 
• Wheat production in China increased from 32,575 thousand tonnes in 1971 to 134,250 thousand tonnes in 2020.
 
• It is the **first largest wheat producer** in the world.
 
• **Wheat production in India** is estimated to increase to a record **109.52 million tonnes **in 2020-21.
 
• **India is the second largest **wheat producer in the world.
 
• Wheat production in **Russia** in 2020-21 was put at **84.5 million**
 
• **Russia is the third ****largest** wheat producer in the world.
 
• In 2020, wheat production for** the United States of America was 49,691 thousand tonnes.**
 
• **US is the fourth largest** wheat producer in the world.
